key_highlights: RBA hikes interest rates to an 18-year high, forcing major banks to lift mortgage rates and sounding recession alarms.
Department store giant David Jones faces imminent administration amid overdue rent disputes with Westfield landlord Scentre Group.
Australian dollar comes under intense pressure, hit by local recession headwinds and macroeconomic deceleration.
Tech and gig-economy sectors absorb major blows following Canva's 1,200+ job cuts and Uber's landmark $81m High Court payroll tax defeat.

sectors.trend: Aggressive monetary policy pass-through with mortgage rates pushed to multi-year highs amid escalating default and recession concerns.
sectors.implications: NIM tailwinds for major banks (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX) are increasingly overshadowed by surging credit impairment risks and decelerating credit growth.

sectors.trend: Severe solvency strain on legacy department stores and discretionary retailers triggered by household cash flow depletion.
sectors.implications: David Jones's impending administration highlights widespread vulnerabilities across discretionary retailers facing plummeting consumer footfall and high fixed rents.

sectors.trend: Heightened tenant default risks and unpaid lease liabilities impacting commercial and shopping centre landlords.
sectors.implications: Westfield owner Scentre Group (SCG.AX) and retail peers face renegotiation, rental writedowns, and costly re-tenanting headwinds.

sectors.trend: Valuation compression, aggressive corporate restructuring, and expanding gig-economy labour tax liabilities.
sectors.implications: Canva's mass layoffs and Uber's $81m High Court contractor ruling set an expensive precedent for platform operators and venture-backed tech multiples.

sectors.trend: Divergence between bulk export headwinds in the Pilbara and exploration progress in titanium, polymetallics, and critical minerals.
sectors.implications: Iron ore heavyweights face mounting supply-demand volatility, whereas junior explorers with strategic assets attract speculative capital.

sectors.trend: Crude oil volatility driven by conflicting geopolitical headlines and global demand deterioration.
sectors.implications: Energy producers face revenue volatility as crude slumps, with market sentiment capped by global recessionary expectations.

key_themes: Aggressive RBA policy tightening triggering acute mortgage stress and recession risks
Structural distress in discretionary brick-and-mortar retail and commercial property landlords
Labour and contractor regulatory tightening affecting gig-economy operating models
Currency depreciation (AUD) driven by macroeconomic slowdown and global trade shifts

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA Rate Hikes and Macroeconomic Recession
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight domestic cyclical equities; rotate into defensive, cash-generative healthcare and consumer staples.
Reduce retail REIT allocations exposed to department store anchors; focus on industrial and logistics property assets.
Review ASX platform and tech service holdings for retrospective payroll tax exposures and contractor reclassification risk.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Commodity Price Volatility & Pilbara Supply Shocks
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain exposure to low-cost producers (BHP.AX, RIO.AX) with robust balance sheets while reducing high-cost marginal miners.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight defensive offshore earners and healthcare
opportunities.rationale: Resilient non-cyclical demand and offshore earnings benefit from AUD weakness while sidestepping domestic mortgage pain.

opportunities.recommendation: Strategic focus on low-cost diversified resources and gold
opportunities.rationale: High-grade resources and strong balance sheets provide safe-haven attributes and margin resilience during economic downshifts.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Divest retail REITs and discretionary consumer retailers
defensive_moves.rationale: Imminent collapse of David Jones and rate hike pressure threaten retail mall rental receipts and household purchasing power.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge benchmark equity exposure against bank credit contraction
defensive_moves.rationale: Recession warnings from major lenders and peak interest rate drag present systemic downside risk to the broader ASX 200.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish and volatile over 1–3 months as markets digest the RBA's cash rate shock, rising retail insolvencies, and bank credit contraction.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautious 6–12 month outlook with persistent GDP deceleration, potential recession risks, and subdued consumer activity preceding eventual rate cuts.
key_catalysts: RBA post-meeting monetary policy statement and revised economic projections
David Jones voluntary administration appointment and creditor settlement negotiations

Scentre Group (SCG.AX) updates on department store occupancy and rent arrears
Australian housing market auction clearance rates and delinquency metrics
Global benchmark crude oil and Pilbara iron ore spot prices
